data_fields.name: conservativeRadius
data_fields.donor_constant: sqrt(max|x|^2 + max|y|^2 + max|z|^2) of the mesh box

best_idea: Batch by (mesh, material) and upload only the dirty slots each frame through a bit mask, clearing the mask atomically so a mark made during the upload is kept.
decision_why: The batch key and dirty-slot patch are what a browser build can use with partial buffer updates; the mesh-shader and indirect GPU culling need GPU features a browser build cannot assume, so they are rejected.
acceptance: In a zone with 200 creatures sharing three meshes and two materials the renderer issues at most six batch draws per frame; after one creature moves the upload covers one slot; a test checks that a mark made during a patch is present in the next patch.
